name: Haus Sarah
beschreibung: The inn Haus Sarah is located in a district of Neustift im Stubaital. The rooms are furnished with traditional wooden furniture and offer modern comfort. Breakfast is served daily, and regional products are also available on request. In summer, hiking trails start directly from the house; in winter, the Stubaier Gletscher ski area is easily reachable. The family-run management of the house creates a pleasant and relaxed atmosphere.
